original: (10.10.26’) vaśām evāmṛtam āhur vaśāṃ mṛtyum upāsate |

original: (10.10.26.c) vaśedaṃ sarvam abhavad devā manuṣyā asurāḥ pitara ṛṣayaḥ ‖26‖

original: (10.10.28.c) tāsāṃ yā madhye rājati sā vaśā duṣpratigrahā ‖28‖

original: (10.10.30’) vaśā dyaur vaśā pṛthivī vaśā viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ |
analyzed: vaśā dyauḥ vaśā pṛthivī vaśā viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ

original: (10.10.30.c) vaśāyā dugdham apibant sādhyā vasavaś ca ye ‖30‖
analyzed: vaśāyāḥ dugdham apiban sādhyāḥ vasavaḥ ca ye

original: (10.10.31’) vaśāyā dugdhaṃ pītvā sādhyā vasavaś ca ye |
analyzed: vaśāyāḥ dugdham pītvā sādhyāḥ vasavaḥ ca ye

original: (10.10.31.c) te vai bradhnasya viṣṭapi payo asyā upāsate  ‖31‖

original: (10.10.34.c) vaśedaṃ sarvam abhavad yāvat sūryo vipaśyati ‖34‖ {35}
